description: List the 50 ADB member economy codes used to query the Key Indicators Database. Returns each economy's 3-letter code and full name. These codes are used as economy_codes in adbkidb.data queries. Key codes: PRC (China), IND (India), JPN (Japan), INO (Indonesia), KOR (Korea), PAK (Pakistan), BAN (Bangladesh), PHI (Philippines), VIE (Viet Nam), THA (Thailand). Note: China is PRC (not CHN), Indonesia is INO (not IDN), Bangladesh is BAN (not BGD). Source: kidb.adb.org — Asian Development Bank member economy reference.

search.description: Optional keyword to filter ADB member economies by code or name (e.g. "india", "PRC", "south"). Leave empty to list all 50 ADB member economies with their 3-letter codes.

name: adbkidb.explore.economies
